results.title: A Room of Their Own
results.overview: In the intimacy of their rooms, Claude-Emmanuelle, Régina, and Nicole apply makeup in front of mirrors. Their precise, repetitive gestures become rituals of transformation and self-affirmation. Fragments of past, secret thoughts, and desires emerge through their voices. Interwoven with images of the city, the film links private experiences to the universal, exploring destinies that brush against each other without ever crossing paths.

results.title: Zanjeerain
results.overview: Bound by family expectations and dark secrets, lives intertwine as love and betrayal test their strength to break free from emotional chains.

results.title: Después de Kim
results.overview: Juan and Gloria, divorced and estranged for 20 years, must travel from Buenos Aires to Spain upon receiving the news that Kim, their daughter with whom they lost contact long ago, has been found dead. Upon arrival, they discover that the deceased has left behind a grandson whose whereabouts are unknown, a discovery that compels them to stay in Spain to find him.

results.title: The Comet
results.overview: Eight-year-old Émile is enjoying the last of the warm summer evenings with his sister Françoise. While they are eagerly scanning the night sky for shooting stars, they are suddenly interrupted by a despicably cruel act.

results.title: Two Mountains Weighing Down My Chest
results.original_title: Two Mountains Weighing Down My Chest
results.overview: A Chinese misfit ricochets between Berlin’s alternative frenzy and Beijing’s family order, transforming cultural whiplash into an offbeat search for identity and a playful quest for belonging.

results.title: Roof
results.overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

results.title: El Pistolero
results.overview: José, a street performer who dreams about becoming a telenovela star, is recruited by a talent manager who promises him great success, but soon realizes the job is actually dancing in a gay strip club. Away from his home and enjoying the newfound fame he has acquired with his new job in the city, José starts wondering if turning his back on his family and himself is worth it now that he's the club's biggest star, nicknamed "El Pistolero."

results.title: Drinking and Driving
results.overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

results.title: Ekadesham
results.overview: In Kochi, the lives, work, and relationships of a bunch of young people overlap as they try to navigate their role in the film world.

results.title: The Buzz
results.overview: During a live national television interview, Veronica, a celebrated and admired actress, struggles to uphold the image of a perfect life while her inner world fractures under the weight of private abuse. Trapped between silence, fear, and a sudden panic attack, she must decide whether to continue performing the illusion—or break the cycle in front of everyone.

results.title: Brexit: The Night That Changed Britain
results.original_title: Brexit: The Night That Changed Britain
results.overview: The ITV News team remembers the night, 10 years ago, when the UK voted to leave the EU.

results.title: Trevlig midsommarhelg!
results.overview: The highlight of the summer in Västerköping! Gunnar and Marianne celebrate traditionally with the children, herring, schnapps and Gunnar's own kubb rules. At Tom and Yvonne's the celebration risks being canceled while Präst-Björn is intoxicated by the summer and Vino Tinto. For Terese, "7 kinds of flowers under the pillow" brings unexpected consequences and opportunities.

results.title: Fatboy Slim: Radio 1's Big Weekend 2026
results.overview: Radio 1’s Big Weekend returns to Sunderland’s Herrington Country Park for the first time since 2005, with 100 acts set to perform across three days of live music. Kicking off the festival as Friday night’s Main Stage headliner is the ultimate party starter, Fatboy Slim. The man who helped take dance music from club floors to festival main stages worldwide is set to bring his legendary show to the north east for a high-energy, hands-in-the-air frenzy. With what promises to be a blockbuster set, expect crowd favourites and his trademark barefoot style - this is the ultimate Friday night Dance Party.

results.title: Jonna: Crónicas de una policía novata
results.original_title: Jonna: Crónicas de una policía novata

results.title: Worth More Than Gold
results.overview: A resilient woman trying to outrun a traumatic past crosses paths with a man fighting to redeem himself from a life of crime together they battle secrets, betrayal, and survival, discovering that true love is worth more than gold.

results.title: Little Tragedies
results.overview: In 2011, Daniel Nolasco moved from his small hometown in the Brazilian countryside to Rio de Janeiro. He went to college. He was the first of a group of queer friends to leave the city. Ten years later, none of the people who made up that group live there anymore; some have died, and those who are alive have moved away. The city is called Catalão, a place that everyone says is too good to live in.

results.title: Providence and the Guitar
results.overview: In a distant past, Léon and Elvira Berthelini, itinerant artists, make their living hopping from town to town. In Covarronca, harassed by the Police Commissioner, they are forced to spend the night out in the open. That’s when they meet Stubbs, a young Cambridge student, with whom they find shelter in the home of a painter at odds with his wife. In return for the hospitality, they remind their hosts that the love of art resolves the art of love. Meanwhile, an unusual curse sends them on absurd journeys into the 21st century, where the future of social security and of a rock band are at stake.

results.title: Tomader Golpo 2
results.overview: Ratul’s grandmother wants him to marry Shaila soon, but since Ratul’s mother married against her family’s wishes in the past, the two families no longer have a good relationship, so Ratul’s family now tries to bring them together again for the wedding.

results.title: Dance For Your Life
results.overview: Dance for Your Life is a powerful testament to the transformative power of dance, where every leap is a story, every setback a lesson, and every moment a chance to be seen.

results.title: Stardom Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Finals~
results.overview: Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Finals~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 15, 2026, at the Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan. It primarily focused on the semi-final and final matches for the company's annual single-elimination tournament, as well as other featured bouts.
